_comment: Advisories the nightly audit gate tolerates, one row per pinned package version.
scripts/audit_exceptions.py turns these into --ignore-vuln flags and refuses to run if a lock
no longer pins the version an entry was written for, so an entry cannot outlive the pin it
excuses. Two kinds of row: `tolerate_advisories_fixing_only_at` excuses whatever the audit
reports for that version while every one of those advisories is fixed by the release a
third-party cap keeps unreachable - it needs --report, and an advisory fixed anywhere else
stays red because the upgrade would not have helped. `ids` names advisories explicitly, for
the case with no fix release at all. Never add a row without a reason naming the cap.

exceptions.reason: Streamlit caps `pillow<13` in every release up to 1.66.0, so 13.0.0 - the only release fixing any advisory published for 12.3.0 (24 of them as of 2026-10-22, a batch that grew twice in one night), and itself clean - cannot be pinned while the app is a Streamlit app. Five of the advisories need a TIFF/GIF/PPM/PDF/EPS to be opened; the only decode in this repository refuses those formats (src/xai_utils.py SALIENCY_IMAGE_EXTENSIONS, guarded by tests/test_pillow_decode_surface.py).
exceptions.revisit: scripts/pillow_cap_check.py fails the nightly the moment the pinned Streamlit stops capping 13.0.0; then raise the pin and delete this row.

exceptions.reason: The fix is 1.5.0, which PyCaret forbids in the all-engine lock; src/task_catalog.py records what 1.5 costs TPOT too. An advisory fixed in a 1.4.x patch would stay red here, and should be: that bump is available.
The fix is 83.0.0 - which dropped pkg_resources that TPOT and autogluon-multimodal import - or 84.1.0, a later release the same cap keeps out; requirements-all.in pins setuptools<81 for exactly that.
exceptions.revisit: The day neither engine imports pkg_resources.

exceptions.reason: No fixed release: the PyPI record lists an empty fix_versions.
exceptions.revisit: nltk publishing a release that closes GHSA-8mgp-746c-j5xp.
